data.description:
## Testing-mode: GREEN

## Objective
Insert a dso.workflow shim block into plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh so that all RED tests from task 7744-d54a-8320-4261 pass.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh — insert shim block

## Insertion Point
After the config_file resolution block (currently lines 42-53) and BEFORE the existing missing-file exit-0 check (currently line 54-57). The shim intercepts key==dso.workflow before the general graceful-degradation path.

## Shim Logic to Insert
```bash
# ── dso.workflow canonical key: shim for backward-compatible legacy key mapping ──
if [[ "$key" == "dso.workflow" ]]; then
    if [[ ! -f "$config_file" ]]; then
        echo "DSO: No .claude/dso-config.conf found. Run /dso:onboarding to configure dso.workflow." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    # Canonical key present — return directly (no deprecation)
    _canonical=$(grep -m1 "^dso\.workflow=" "$config_file" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
    if [[ -n "$_canonical" ]]; then
        printf '%s' "$_canonical"
        exit 0
    fi
    # Legacy key fallback — read merge.strategy + enforcement.strategy
    _merge=$(grep -m1 "^merge\.strategy=" "$config_file" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
    _enforce=$(grep -m1 "^enforcement\.strategy=" "$config_file" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
    if [[ -z "${DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET:-}" ]]; then
        echo "DSO deprecation: merge.strategy/enforcement.strategy are deprecated. Set dso.workflow=ci-pr|local in .claude/dso-config.conf" >&2
    fi
    if [[ "$_merge" == "pr" && "$_enforce" == "ci" ]]; then
        printf '%s' "ci-pr"
    else
        printf '%s' "local"
    fi
    exit 0
fi
```

## Behavioral Invariants
- All 35 existing callers of read-config.sh with non-dso.workflow keys: behavior unchanged
- Missing config + key != dso.workflow: still exits 0 (existing graceful degradation)
- Missing config + key == dso.workflow: exits 1 with stderr message
- Canonical dso.workflow key present: returns value, no deprecation
- Legacy keys only: returns mapped value, emits deprecation to stderr
- DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET set: no stderr output

## Done Definition
bash tests/run-all.sh passes (all RED tests from 7744-d54a-8320-4261 now GREEN). No regressions in existing test-read-config.sh tests.
data.title: GREEN: Add dso.workflow inline shim block to read-config.sh
